title: Pharmacist: Safety Alignment Data Curation for Large Language Models against Harmful Fine-tuning
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety alignment and data curation techniques to prevent large language models from generating harmful content. While the evaluation includes examples involving unethical behavior (e.g., a teacher-student relationship), the paper's primary objective is technical safety and robustness rather than benchmarking or evaluating religion, moral reasoning, or specific ethical frameworks.
